user.title: Connect CTS600 through transparent TCP
user.description: Submit only after disconnecting the physical panel and confirming CN6 wiring. Setup starts panel emulation, sends T15 and switches the display language to English. Use 19200 8N2 and Protocol NONE on the gateway. VP18 K menus still require commissioning tests.

init.title: Room sensors and external inputs
init.description: Choose your own sensors and permission helpers. Optional inputs can be cleared. Continue to configure passive simulation and night heating. Saving reloads the integration and preserves entity identities.

shadow.title: Passive DHW simulation (optional)
shadow.description: Select existing helpers. Blank inputs use documented defaults; no enable helper keeps collection off. No helper names are required.

night.title: Night DHW heating (optional)
night.description: Select the enable helper, target, two time-only helpers, block duration and timestamp-keyed 15-minute price curve. No selection enables heating automatically.
